comments.text: The issue with the Steam Machine is the same thing with PS6 or Project Helix that was just reported by Moore’s Law Is Dead: Sony HAS to produce the PS6 in 2027 because they already have a designed chip with AMD and have a contract with AMD/TSMC to reserve fab capacity. If Sony delays, then they’ll have to buy new capacity at a higher price and it will be whenever TSMC has it available. And there isn’t any guarantee that RAM prices will fall by 2028 unless the AI bubble collapses, which would probably create its own problem in that it is single handedly propping up the economy….so we’d have cheaper consoles that nobody can afford.
